title: About Me
text:
I am a PhD-trained Computational Biologist with over six years of experience combining molecular biology and bioinformatics to investigate complex biological questions.
My research has focused on comparative genomics, population genomics, transcriptomics, and genome evolution. Throughout my academic career I have designed scalable computational workflows capable of analyzing hundreds of sequencing datasets.
Although my background originates in evolutionary biology, my strongest expertise lies in computational problem solving, reproducible workflows, and extracting biological insights from large datasets.
